items.q: What should you remember about **Start from strength**?
items.a: **"What's going right" is truth-aligned, not** toxic positivity; positions you to change what isn't working from power not helplessness.

items.q: What should you remember about **Compassionate curiosity only ingredient**?
items.a: **self-inquiry can be playful;** fear/stigma makes aloneness anxiety-provoking unnecessarily.

items.q: What should you remember about **Balance doing and thinking**?
items.a: **too much doing →** diminishing returns/unsatisfaction; too little → learned helplessness; map your profile.

items.q: What should you remember about **Overconnection erodes aloneness**?
items.a: **social media can strengthen or distract from** self; sweet spot = some external check-ins + enough solitude to form own questions first.

items.q: What should you remember about **Externalizing thoughts helps**?
items.a: **speech/writing holds brain accountable; internal-only loops get stuck.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Examine choices, not just inventory**?
items.a: **examined life reveals ~80%** autopilot; agency begins with "why am I doing this?".

items.q: What should you remember about **Insight frees; opposition traps**?
items.a: **repeating parent's pattern OR** doing opposite both fail without understanding healthy middle.

items.q: What should you remember about **Anti-control is agency lever**?
items.a: **you're not your enemy; find** why you block yourself (fear of failure, unworthiness, overcommitment to others).

items.q: What should you remember about **Self-talk audit first**?
items.a: **intrusive thoughts often unconscious;** always carry meaning worth exploring.

items.q: What should you remember about **Prime positive climate**?
items.a: **photos, memories, "what went** right" counter negative unconscious bias.

items.q: What should you remember about **Happiness ≠ escape**?
items.a: **real happiness holds tragedy** awareness + contentment; happy-go-lucky avoids grounding.
